column1: # Part-of-speech rulings — the cards `corpus:posfix` cannot decide by rule.
# posfix infers two classes safely, each validated against the ~6,900 cards that
# already carry a pos: an article plus a single token is a noun (99.5% agreement),
# and a single token whose English gloss opens with "to" is a verb (99.8%). What is
# left is function words, adjectives and adverbs, where no surface feature decides
# it — so each is a decision, recorded here and applied by posfix.
#   viel / wenig  -> adjective, not pronoun. They grade (mehr, meist) and decline
#                    adjectivally (viele, wenige); DaF teaches them either way.
#   gleich        -> adjective. Glossed "same / shortly"; the adverbial reading is
#                    secondary and the card teaches the adjective.
#   zwar          -> adverb, not particle. It is a Konnektor here (zwar … aber),
#   allein        -> adverb. Predicative "alone"; the adjectival use is marginal.
